Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the time today - great discussion. As promised, here's a short recap and the next steps so we can keep momentum on the Private/VPC deployment evaluation:

Key items we covered:
- SOC 2: status and expected date for Type II (helps with procurement timeline)
- GDPR / data residency and any HIPAA requirements
- Vendor security questionnaire (we can collect your completed copy to expedite procurement)
- Private deployment options: VPC peering vs. private control plane vs. on-prem air-gapped option
- Network isolation details we need (CIDR, egress rules, proxy/NAT requirements)

Action items for Acme:
1) Share current SOC 2 status and any audit timeline (Type I/II).
2) Confirm whether HIPAA applies; if so we will scope the BAA path.
3) Complete the attached vendor security questionnaire (or share your own) - this will help our security team triage the controls quickly.
4) Provide preferred times for a 45-minute architecture review with Priyom (our solutions engineer) - we recommend someone from your network/security team join.

From our side:
- Priyom will prepare a draft private deployment diagram and a short checklist of network/firewall requirements.
- We'll propose an initial configuration: private control plane in your VPC (no public ingress), optional dedicated GPU pool (for Dedicated customers), KMS integration for customer-managed keys, and an on-prem agent for fully air-gapped workloads if required.

I've attached the vendor questionnaire template for convenience. Let me know if you'd rather send your own questionnaire instead.

Thanks - looking forward to the architecture call.

Best,
Marcus Lin

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Security & VPC deployment follow-up - SOC 2, GDPR, vendor questionnaire

Hi Jordan - thanks for the questionnaire and the SOC update. A few technical clarifications and what we'll bring to the architecture review:

Recommended initial architecture (summary):
- Private control plane deployed in a customer VPC with VPC peering to our inference subnet (no public ingress).
- TLS + mTLS for control-plane and runtime connections; customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key) for encrypting stored model artifacts and logs.
- Network egress: minimal outbound to Redwood-managed S3 endpoints (we can also support VPC endpoints if preferred).
- KV cache and inference traffic are isolated per-tenant; recommend dedicated subnets and security groups for inference nodes when using dedicated capacity.
- For on-prem/air-gapped options: we provision a packaged runtime (air-gapped bundle) and an on-prem agent that pulls model artifacts over an approved transfer process; this is a multi-week engagement for validation.

Questions for your network team before the call:
- Preferred CIDR range(s) for peered VPC(s) and any reserved IP ranges we should avoid.
- Firewall rules: outbound ports we should expect to be allowed (e.g., 443/TCP to Redwood endpoints, optional 9000-9100 for internal metrics if using a private metrics forwarder).
- Do you require an egress proxy or specific NAT arrangement?

I've attached a draft deployment diagram (redwood_private_deployment_diagram_v1.pdf) that illustrates the VPC peering and an optional on-prem path. Also linking the doc here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-acme-arch

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm a 45-minute slot Wed 2026-07-16 10:30 PT for the architecture review (Marcus will coordinate calendar invite).
2) Jordan: share CIDR + a short list of firewall/NAT constraints prior to the call.
3) Our security team will review the attached questionnaire and follow up on any gaps by EOD Thu.

Thanks - Priyom
